verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a payment SDK and platform like Stripe Terminal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry setting, usage-tracking control, or opt-out mechanism for the Terminal SDKs, readers, CLI, or MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
